sample_text: Whoa... wait a second. One trillion dollars? In sixty-one days?! Heh. That's about a hundred and ninety-two thousand dollars... every single second. Not today, price tag! Okay. Relax... I have a plan.

variants.name: Buck A (Trickster)
variants.prompt: An eccentric, theatrical, and wildly expressive comedic male voice. Playful, unpredictable rhythm with sudden pauses, dramatic gasps, and sly chuckles. Sounds like a charming, witty rogue adventure hero—slurred slightly with amusement, full of personality and warmth, never robotic or flat.

variants.name: Buck B (Adventurer)
variants.prompt: A fast-talking, hyper-expressive, charismatic young male voice actor with big comedic timing. Shifts rapidly from whispered secrets to excited shouts, full of breathy laughs and crisp American diction.

variants.name: Buck C (Con-Artist)
variants.prompt: A smooth, cheeky, theatrical animated character voice with bouncy intonation, playful sarcasm, and dramatic inflection. Warm, resonant, and bursting with human emotion and comedic pauses.

variants.name: Buck D (Wisecracker)
variants.prompt: A fast, sarcastic, wisecracking adult male comedic voice with a slightly raspy mid-range tone and a smirk in every line. Irreverent, self-aware motormouth who talks straight to the audience, tosses off dry asides, then snaps into mock-dramatic intensity. Sharp American diction, playful swagger, quick comic timing, never flat or robotic.
